values.note: Reserve by phone with the campground manager (913-290-0034), up to one week; otherwise pay the manager on arrival before choosing a pad. Memorial Day, July 4th and Labor Day weekends must be booked at least 14 days ahead and paid in full (non-refundable). A $20 cash key deposit for the restroom/shower house is refunded at check-out (waived for self-contained RVs). Only three shared water spigots - bring a hose and splitter.

values.note: City of Leavenworth: $20 a night with electricity and shower house use (2025 information sheet and current city page). A refundable $20 cash key deposit is taken per stay.

note: City of Leavenworth campground at 1201 Riverfront Park Road, on the Missouri River bank just north of the Centennial Bridge, reached across an active railroad: campers 32 ft or longer drag on the crossing. The campground gate is kept locked. --Claude
summary: City page + dated 2025 sheet read today: 13 pads, 30 A, 3 shared water spigots, no sewer, showers, dump, $20, Apr 1-Oct 31, phone reservations up to 7 nights. Riverfront kept (river-side pads 10-20 m from the Missouri bank, no levee). Pin ~430 m off - move. Phone added.
flags: PIN MOVE: stored 39.328,-94.9103 is the boat-ramp parking lot ~430 m SOUTH of the campground (south of the Centennial Bridge). Move to the campground loop, about 39.3319,-94.9106 (Google 39.33197,-94.91077 is on the loop; imagery shows the 13 pads 39.3310-39.3330). Re-check elevation.

WATERFRONT riverfront kept. Imagery: the east-side pads (about 6 of 13, map sites 4-9) jut east off the loop road toward the river, and between their ends and the Missouri is 10-20 m of open grass and an open bank with scattered trees - no levee, no road, no day use; the railroad and the water-treatment plant are on the landward (west) side. The Missouri here is ~250 m wide (riverfront, not creekside). West-side pads are behind the loop road (view only).

RAILROAD: the city says campers 32 ft or longer drag on the track crossing - a length/break-over problem, not a height limit; EKKO (~24 ft) is inside the 32 ft the city recommends. The crossing has no stated clearance or height limit. Active trains alongside (noise).
HOOKUPS: no water at the pads - three shared water outlets (hose and splitter), so hookups.water left unset and potable_water written; sewer false per the 2025 sheet.
